_comment: Gates that stand OPEN (tool frame: x east, z north, metres from the statue): two stone posts and two iron leaves swung back along the way through. heading = direction of travel, degrees clockwise from north; width = between the posts; lanterns, arch (free edge higher by this fraction of the leaf), sideGate {width, side} (a narrow people's gate beside the main one, side 1 = right-hand when travelling). `walls`: garden walls as polylines (points, height, thick, kind rubble|plaster). Exported to city.json `gates` / `stoneWalls` (tool/export_web.dart), built by web3d/src/gates.ts. In reality the gates are shut to the public.

gates.name: Kaptol south: the big gate where the private road along the palace's south garden starts (Ulica Tome Bakača / Pod zidom roundabout)
gates.source: Street View photosphere Apr 2019 (Zagreb, G. P. Maffei) and the user's Street View frame: wrought-iron double gate between cream posts with lanterns, a narrow gate to its right, a rubble wall beyond it and a white garden wall to its left

gates.name: Kaptol north path: the gate by Domitrovićeva kula where the private road along the outside of the wall starts
gates.source: Google Maps satellite and OSM (service roads access=no / private from the Kaptol roundabout along the north wall)

gates.name: East path: the gate between the south-east tower and the glasshouse where the private road up the east side of the palace starts
gates.source: Google Maps satellite and OSM (service road access=private from Ulica Jurja Branjuga past the south-east tower to the palace's rear)

walls.name: Rubble garden wall east of the big gate: along the lawn edge up to the corner of the Vlaška house (Lacković-Žigrović), into its wall
Rubble garden wall west of the big gate: straight to Kula Nebojan, into its wall, leaving the lawn with the flower bed outside (Google Maps 3D)
